title: Hippocrates Wellness Launches Annual European Tour in May 2019
excerpt: WEST PALM BEACH, Florida, April 12, 2019 – Hippocrates Wellness has announced their touring lectures through Europe during the months of May and June.
content:
WEST PALM BEACH, Florida, April 12, 2019 – Hippocrates Wellness has announced their touring lectures through Europe during the months of May and June. This tour will include visits to Sweden, Finland, Denmark, the Netherlands, Germany, Poland and Switzerland and other countries to be announced, to educate on the benefits of natural health and the keys to longevity.

The keynote lectures for the tour will include “Quantum Human Biology,” “Manopause,” “Power of a Woman” and “Food As Medicine.”

The Institute (a 501 C3) has decades of research and experience helping individuals achieve an elevated level of health by participating in their signature programs and raw vegan, plant-based diet. During this European tour, Hippocrates Co-Directors Brian and Anna Maria Clement will be lecturing, answering questions, and will also share their experience and best practices for wellness and healthy living.

For more information regarding the May-June 2019 Hippocrates European Tour, then visit the website www.hippocratesinst.org
